claims.statement: Enemy skill selection is partially reconstructable from database fields including initial timeout, delay, chance, range, and chained skills.
Displayed Monster Database skill values are not by themselves the final incoming damage because percentage bonuses and some equipment are not accounted for in the displayed skill panel.
Physical damage mitigation varies by randomly selected armor location, so a single aggregate armor rating can hide lethal tail risk.
A fixed single-superboss tank test is not equivalent to Shattered Realm survival because SR adds depth scaling, randomized mutators, and potentially multiple Nemesis enemies.
Sunder can amplify subsequent Sunder and other debuff magnitudes in the tested 1.2.1.6-era public-test behavior.
claims.notes: Community fixed-damage tests support the observation, but intent and current stable/public-test behavior are not established.

claims.statement: A local, read-only ARZ ingestion pipeline is technically feasible without depending on GrimTools page scraping.
ARZ and DBR values do not fully define combat semantics because template behavior is implemented by compiled engine code unavailable through normal modding data.

All possible combat outcomes cannot be practically enumerated from static data because runtime position, random state, concurrent enemies, timing, and player actions create a combinatorial state space.
claims.notes: This is an architectural inference from the documented data/runtime boundary and encounter variables.
